flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminprivateapi: framework/workflows/agencies/toppan/upload/{jobs/ToppanLettersGeneratorJob, jobs/ToppanUploadJob, helpers/ToppanUploadHelper, models/ToppanStage}, crud/ocmsizdb/OcmsValidOffenceNotice/OcmsValidOffenceNoticeRepository (findToppanNoticesForStage), framework/services/agencyFileExchange/AgencyFileExchangeServiceImpl, framework/services/comcryptSftpBlob/helper/ComcryptUploadProcessor, framework/schedulers/ToppanUploadJobsScheduler, framework/controllers/ToppanUnifiedController, resources/{cron-schedules-prod.properties, application-prod.properties}. ocmsadminapi workflows/operational/cronproxy and ocmsadminui pages/Cron/list/CronList.tsx are only the manual trigger. ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi: not used. The old copy ocmsadminprivateapi/cronservice/ is ignored (stale)
note: Status in stories.json: Demo paid (50% of 75%); demo_remark: SFTP Code Split, SFTP permission granted to the App Service (cannot verify from repo). There is no flow deck, so Sesuai means the code does what the story text says. This is the hirer version of OCMS12.7: the hirer 2nd letter is stage DN2 (ToppanStage.DN2, next DR3), processed by the same Toppan Generate Letters job as RD2. Notice selection, the 719-character fixed-width file and the ocms_driver_notice record exist. Gaps: (1) sftp.upload.disabledServers=toppan in dev/UAT/prod (application-prod.properties:86) so the file never reaches the Toppan SFTP, and the delivery gate is bypassed so the stage still advances to DR3 (OCMS-DF-2026-192, Ready to UAT); (2) the 00:15 cron is enabled=true but the call toppanLettersGeneratorService.executeJob() inside executeDayEndJobs is commented out, so letters are only generated through the manual trigger (staff portal Cron List -> POST /toppan/generate-letters); (3) the letter_address fallback after Toppan does not include furnished_mail, although a furnished hirer usually has only that address (possible bug, not proven end to end). No PDF is made for DN2; the story allows PDF or data file. Conformance to the Toppan specification, vendor receipt and the SFTP permission cannot be verified from repo.
recommendation: Claim partially. The DN2 file for the hirer is built correctly but is not delivered to the vendor while sftp.upload.disabledServers=toppan, and no automatic schedule generates it. Ask URA when the Toppan block is lifted and the generate-letters cron is switched on, plus proof that Toppan received a DN2 file

steps.step: OCMS selects hirer notices due for the 2nd letter (stage DN2): not suspended and the hirer is the current offender
steps.detail: ToppanStage has DN1 -> DN2 -> DR3 (ToppanStage.java:22-23). ToppanLettersGeneratorJob runs every stage in order, including DN2 (ToppanLettersGeneratorJob.java:151-154), and each stage calls getValidOffenceNoticesOptimized (ToppanUploadJob.java:248; ToppanUploadHelper.java:1887) which uses findToppanNoticesForStage: next_processing_stage = :stage, next_processing_date <= today, suspension_type IS NULL, an_flag not 'Y', joined to owner_driver with offender_indicator = 'Y' (OcmsValidOffenceNoticeRepository.java:583-614). The query does not tell a hirer from an owner except through the stage; DN2 is the driver/hirer track (comment in ToppanDownloadJob.java:29). PS-FOR and similar notices are filtered in the same helper. The VON rows in the DB cannot be verified from repo.

steps.step: The letter uses the hirer address updated by the particulars checks; notices without a letter address are left out
steps.detail: Addresses are enriched from ocms_offence_notice_owner_driver_addr per notice and owner_driver_indicator (enrichNoticesWithAddressesOptimized, ToppanUploadHelper.java:2022 and 2151-2160); the priority order is mha_reg, lta_reg, lta_mail, furnished_mail (ToppanUploadHelper.java:2319-2320) and only an address with letter_address='Y' is used. Notices with no address are dropped (F-17, ToppanUploadHelper.java:2026-2050) and filterByLetterAddress runs again before the file is built (ToppanUploadJob.java:266-275). Sebagian because: after the letter goes out, resetLetterAddressAfterToppan re-sets letter_address through the chain mha_reg -> lta_reg -> lta_mail without furnished_mail (ToppanUploadHelper.java:467-468, 517). A hirer that has only a furnished_mail address may lose the 'Y' flag for the next letter; this is a possible bug not proven end to end. Who sets the initial letter_address='Y' on a furnished address: cannot verify from repo (not traced).

steps.step: OCMS builds the 2nd letter data file (PDF or data file) for the vendor to print and post
steps.detail: File name URA-DPT-DN2-D1-<yyyyMMddHHmmss> (ToppanUploadJob.java:278-282), content built by createRequestFileContent('TOPPAN_DN2') (ToppanUploadJob.java:286-292; AgencyFileExchangeServiceImpl.java:79-88): 719-character fixed-width with header H, one detail per notice sorted by postal code (name, address, letter date; buildToppanDetailLine, AgencyFileExchangeServiceImpl.java:648-661) and trailer T holding the record count (AgencyFileExchangeServiceImpl.java:564-624). The original file is uploaded to Azure Blob (ToppanUploadJob.java:314). No PDF is made for DN2 (PDF only for ANL); the story allows PDF or data file. Conformance of the layout to the Toppan specification: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: OCMS sends the file to the vendor (Toppan) over SFTP
steps.detail: The code requests a COMCRYPT token for encryption (ToppanUploadJob.java:347-356) and the callback uploads the encrypted file to the Toppan SFTP. But sftp.upload.disabledServers=toppan in application-prod.properties:86 (also UAT and dev, the comment cites OCMS-DF-2026-170), and ComcryptUploadProcessor throws SftpDisabledException for the blocked server (ComcryptUploadProcessor.java:206-208). In the repo configuration the DN2 file is not delivered to the vendor; the real server property value cannot be verified from repo. The SFTP permission for the App Service and receipt on the Toppan side also cannot be verified from repo. OCMS-DF-2026-192 (Ready to UAT) records the cron failing with 'SFTP FAILED' before the gate bypass was fixed.

steps.step: Building and sending the 2nd letter runs as an OCMS batch job (no manual trigger)
steps.detail: The Toppan Upload cron is scheduled at 00:15 and enabled=true (cron-schedules-prod.properties:61-62), but in executeDayEndJobs the call toppanLettersGeneratorService.executeJob() is commented out (ToppanUploadJobsScheduler.java:118; runDayEndJobs at :95-105 only calls executeDayEndJobs). Letters are only generated through the manual trigger: the 'Toppan Generate Letters' button in the staff portal (CronList.tsx:45) -> ocmsadminapi cron proxy (CronProxyController.java:165-169; CronProxyService.java:226-228) -> POST /toppan/generate-letters (ToppanUnifiedController.java:34). So this repo has no automatic daily dispatch. Whether operators trigger it by hand every day in PRD: cannot verify from repo. OCMS-DF-2026-192 mentions the cron being triggered manually from the staff portal.

steps.step: After the file is processed, the notice is recorded as sent the 2nd letter and moves to the next stage (DR3) so the hirer is told of the outstanding fine
steps.detail: updateProcessingStage moves the VON to the next stage (DN2 -> DR3 from ocms_stage_map, enum fallback; ToppanUploadHelper.java:1814-1820), records a row in ocms_driver_notice for DN1/DN2/DR3 (ToppanUploadHelper.java:884-897; bulkRecordDriverNotices :1063-1085, name and address from ONOD) and then resets letter_address (ToppanUploadHelper.java:327-330). Sebagian because confirmDeliveryAndAdvanceStage bypasses the delivery gate while sftp.upload.disabledServers contains toppan (ToppanUploadJob.java:424-430), so the stage advances and the ocms_driver_notice row is written even though the file never reaches the vendor (ToppanUploadJob.java:444). This is recorded in OCMS-DF-2026-192 (Ready to UAT, not Closed). The notice looks as if the letter was sent while the hirer has not been informed.
